# orchestration_cluster_user (Data Source)

A Camunda cluster user

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orchestration_cluster_user" "demo" {
  username = "demo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The unique name of a user.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The email of the user.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of a user (the username).
- `name` (String) The name of the user.
